blocks.html: Maja Salvador strengthens her ties with Robinsons Land Corporation (RLC) as they recently signed her contract renewal that continues her to be the face of the company for the campaigns of Robinsons Malls, Robinsons Hotels and Resorts, RLC Residences, and RHomes.

Maja is a woman who is honest and authentic, traits that resonates deeply with RLC’s warmth and credibility. She started her work as a brand ambassadress of RLC in 2014. Since then, she has been one of the key factors for the company’s success as she uses her wittiness and charisma to give quality entertainment to the people.

In her work as a brand ambassadress for one of the country’s leading property developers, she maintained to be a versatile artist with her finesse and elegance that she puts in all of her performances and at the same time, never loses sight of the importance of family no matter how busy she gets. With that said, she undeniably is the perfect fit to represent RLC on and off-cam.

Like RLC’s rise and growth through the years, Maja remains to sparkle and shine brightly. Through her numerous projects, she has evolved and excelled in her career and personal life – a multi-awarded TV and movie actress, breathtaking onstage performer, and an accomplished brand endorser whose untarnished reputation makes her a reliable ambassador.
Looking forward to an exciting year ahead! Let’s wait and see what electrifying projects and campaigns RLC has prepared for her and its patrons.
